fields.description: The Portman is a 173-home Ellington apartment building in Jumeirah Village Circle, with studios and one- and two-bedroom homes arranged around shared leisure and social spaces.

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact own project page and Portman-labelled documents reviewed; unrelated La Mer header metadata was excluded.
reviewCoverage.location: Own project introduction and community breadcrumb establish Jumeirah Village Circle.
reviewCoverage.residences: Studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments checked against actual plans. Retail drawing is separate and not described as a residential unit.
reviewCoverage.areas: All 16 plan pages extracted; actual full numerical panels 4/ 6/ 12 visually read for all three residential families. Printed total and internal/outdoor measures retained separately.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own named facilities corroborated in own investment guide page 2 and English brochure pages 28–29.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Property Finder headline 715,000 differs from its older studio 442,000 unit reference; neither establishes current developer inventory. No own current price quotation retrieved.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own investment guide page 7 visually read:20+10+10+six 5+30=100. Historical structure, not a new selected-unit contract.
reviewCoverage.handover: Original indexed factsheet forecast Q1 2025 differs from Property Finder April 2026. Own public gallery continues through October 2026 without explicit completion certificate or dated handover notice; card null.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own linked Arabic 13-page investment guide and broker-hosted English 36-page brochure / 16-page plans downloaded. Original indexed factsheet TLS download failed; only indexed historical estimate attributed. Public October 2026 gallery read; no image used as proof of completion. Source pool: slim 100, plans 65, old indexed facts 30; design brochure locator only.

overview: A compact apartment mix is paired with a podium leisure deck and spaces for reading, working and family recreation.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Marketing access times are not measured journey guarantees.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 715,000 at the headline while retaining a lower older studio reference in its unit table. This is not a verified currently available developer unit or a dated quotation.
research.paymentNote: Original schedule shown below; confirm the selected unit’s signed terms and outstanding balances.
research.handoverNote: The indexed original guide forecast Q1 2025; Property Finder gives April 2026. Both have elapsed. The October 2026 developer gallery is not handover certification.

facts.label: Building configuration
facts.value: The original guide lists 16 residential floors, three podiums and a ground floor, with one parking space per apartment.

facts.label: Plan variations
facts.value: The Arabic guide’s studio upper bound 435 ft² and two-bedroom lower bound 948 ft² differ from the individual English plans. The detailed sampled plan totals are used; occasional 0.01 ft² component rounding is preserved.

facts.label: Dated construction information
facts.value: Ellington publishes an October 2026 construction gallery. A gallery date alone does not establish completion or handover.

unresolved: Actual completion and handover are not confirmed by the reviewed public gallery.
Current stock, exact price, signed payment dates and current service charges require a selected-unit quotation.
Investment guide summary area bounds differ from individual plan sheets; actual sale agreement controls.
